name: A Grym Fate
description: Kill the Adamantine Golem without using the Forge Hammer.

name: Absolute Power Corrupts
description: Reign with terror: take control of the Netherbrain and bend the world to your will.

name: Action Surge
description: Perform five attacks in one turn. Your enemies won't know what hit them (literally).

name: All's Well That Ends Well
description: Finish the game (with a heartfelt 'thank you' from Larian Studios).

name: Bedrolls and Breakfast
description: Take four full Long Rests in a single playthrough - adventuring's tiring work.

name: Bookworm
description: Read 100 different books in a single playthrough. Adventuring isn't just daring quests, you know.

name: Bottoms Up
description: Long Rest using only alcohol - a time-honoured dwarven tradition.

name: Busker
description: Earn a hundred gold from playing sweet, sweet music in a single playthrough.

name: Ceremorphosis
description: Make the ultimate sacrifice: become a mind flayer to defeat the Netherbrain.

name: Crash Landing
description: In the Wyrmway, wait until the dragon is mid-flight, then knock it out of the sky - KAPOW.

name: Critical Hit
description: Complete the game in Tactician mode.

name: Descent From Avernus
description: Take control of the nautiloid and escape the Hells.

name: Devil's in the Details
description: Defeat Commander Zhalk on the nautiloid.

name: Dig for Victory
description: Dig up five buried chests in a single playthrough - treasure!

name: Embrace Your Urge
description: Become Bhaal's ultimate weapon - become his Slayer.

name: Escapologist
description: Break out of prison after being arrested - aren't you daring?

name: Expand Your Mind
description: Consume a parasite and unlock a new power - is it meant to wriggle the whole way down?

name: Fancy Footwork
description: Defeat Gortash in Wyrm's Rock without activating any traps.

name: Fetch Quest
description: Play fetch with Scratch - the best boy in the Realms.

name: First Blood
description: Kill Orin while her cultists are performing their ritual chant.

name: Fists of Fury
description: Kill a character with an Unarmed Strike.

name: Foehammer
description: Complete the game in Honour mode.

name: Forged in Blood and Fire
description: Craft an item in the Adamantine Forge.

name: Hero of the Forgotten Realms
description: Save the day: kill the Netherbrain and destroy the Absolute tadpoles.

name: Homebrewer
description: Create three unique alchemical solutions in a single playthrough - bottoms up!

name: Hot Date
description: Go on a date with Karlach - now that's playing with fire.

name: Interfectorem Draconis
description: Kill the red dragon in the Upper City.

name: Jack-of-all-Trades
description: Multiclass into every class in one playthrough without asking Withers to change your character.

name: Just a Nibble
description: Let Astarion bite you - ouch.

name: Kill Two Birds With One Gnome
description: Use one enemy as an improvised weapon against another.

name: Leave No One Behind
description: Save every tiefling refugee you can throughout the game in a single playthrough.

name: Loophole
description: Break Wyll's pact with Mizora.

name: Mind Blown
description: Romance the Emperor.

name: Murder in Baldur's Gate
description: Coat the streets of Baldur's Gate in blood - become an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.

name: No Free Lunches
description: Defeat the Apostle of Myrkul before it consumes any necromites.

name: No Penny Required
description: Successfully use Detect Thoughts to pry into someone's thoughts.

name: Non-Invasive Procedure
description: Kill the Surgeon before he performs surgery on you in combat.

name: Outsourcing
description: Recruit a hireling. You can befriend them or use them as cannon-fodder - we won't judge.

name: Penny Pincher
description: Defeat the Toll Collector without her using gold against you - excellent budgeting.

name: Pest Control
description: Kill the Spider Matriarch before her eggs hatch - why do they have so many legs?

name: Punch Drunk
description: Defeat twenty opponents while a party character is drunk in a single playthrough - down them.

name: Repairing the Weave
description: Stabilise Gale's Netherese orb.

name: Roleplayer
description: Complete ten background goals in a single playthrough - you are one with your character.

name: Rude, Crude, and Full of Attitude
description: Find and summon the quasit Shovel. Or is her name... Fork? Maybe Basket?

name: She Cannot Be Caged!
description: Rescue Sazza from the Emerald Grove, Goblin Camp and Moonrise Towers in one playthrough.

name: Shove Off
description: Kill a creature with falling damage.

name: Sins of the Father
description: Claim your Throne of Blood: take control of the Netherbrain for Bhaal and break the world.

name: Taking Blood
description: Steal the Blood of Lathander from underneath Rosymorn Monastery.

name: The City Awaits
description: Leave Act II - Baldur's Gate is just over the horizon.

name: The Lich-Queen's Wrath
description: Ally with Voss against the githyanki God-Queen. Good luck.

name: The Plot Thickens
description: Leave Act I - for somewhere altogether darker.

name: To Bloom in Darkest Night
description: Gift Shadowheart a night orchid - her favourite flower. Always knew she was a softie.

name: Under Lock and Key
description: Rescue all the prisoners from the depths of Moonrise Towers in one playthrough.

name: You Have Two Hands for a Reason
description: Pet Scratch and the owlbear cub at the same time - the greatest joy an adventurer could ask for.
